definitions.gloss: extremely busy; pressure of business; being overloaded with tasks
definitions.explanation: A formal word describing a state of being overwhelmed with work or having too many things to attend to.

examples.japanese: {御多忙|ごたぼう}{繁多|はんた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}ります→恐れ入る：05914_osoreiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧。
examples.english: I'm sorry to trouble you when you are so busy.
examples.notes: Very formal set phrase used in letters and emails

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧{繁多|はんた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: At year-end, I'm so buried in paperwork that I have no time to rest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{繁多|はんた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、ご⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れました→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{詫|わ}び→お詫び：08266_owabi⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I apologize for the delayed reply due to heavy workload.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written expression most commonly seen in business correspondence and formal letters. Often appears in the set phrase {御多忙|ごたぼう}{繁多|はんた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧ (despite your being extremely busy), used as a polite preamble before making a request.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧{繁多|はんた} (swamped with administrative work)
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{繁多|はんた} (heavy business workload)
- {御多忙|ごたぼう}{繁多|はんた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧ (despite your busy schedule — formal preamble)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多忙|たぼう}→多忙：12166_tabou⟧: very busy — more commonly used, less formal
- ⟦{繁忙|はんぼう}→繁忙：22531_hanbou⟧: busy, hectic — similar formality, used in ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧ (busy season)
